in_hebrew.name: Swen
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Swen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old Norse words ‘svanr’ meaning swan and ‘friðr’ meaning friend. Swen is a name that signifies camaraderie and loyalty, reminiscent of a group of swans gliding together in a graceful formation.
